en-US.description:
Dualist - Simple, Adaptive, Private.

Dualist is a streamlined, high-performance To-Do List application designed for the modern Android ecosystem. It focuses on a seamless transition between mobile and large-screen form factors using a state-of-the-art adaptive architecture.

🌟 KEY FEATURES:

🌓 ADAPTIVE 2-PANE LAYOUT
- Optimized List-Detail pattern that automatically expands to two panes on tablets and foldables.
- Providing a high-productivity workspace for large-screen devices.

🏠 OFFLINE-FIRST & PRIVATE
- All your tasks are stored locally on your device in a robust Room database.
- No cloud sync, no data mining, and no accounts required. Your data stays with you.

🚫 NO GOOGLE SERVICES REQUIRED
- Completely free of Google Play Services (GMS).
- Runs perfectly on de-googled Android distributions and privacy-focused ROMs.

🎨 VIBRANT MATERIAL 3 DESIGN
- A bold, energetic color scheme utilizing the latest Material Design 3 principles.
- Full support for Light and Dark modes.
- Modern edge-to-edge display integration.

✅ CORE TASK MANAGEMENT
- Effortlessly add, check off, and delete tasks.
- Intuitive and responsive interface designed for speed and clarity.

Dualist is the perfect companion for anyone seeking a fast, private, and beautifully designed task manager that feels at home on any device size. Download Dualist today and experience a new standard in adaptive productivity!
en-US.name: Dualist
en-US.summary: Modern, adaptive, and offline-first To-Do List app.
en-US.whatsNew: • Under the Hood Changes so the F-Droid Build should run successful now

en-US.description:
GeoWeather - Your Modern, Privacy-First Weather App

Experience an intuitive weather application inspired by the Swiss MeteoSwiss app. GeoWeather provides you with precise weather information for multiple cities with an elegant, Material You interface.

🌟 KEY FEATURES:

🏙️ MULTIPLE CITIES & SHORTCUTS
- Add unlimited cities to your list
- Quick switching between locations
- App Shortcuts: Jump to your top cities directly from the homescreen

📅 UP TO 16-DAY FORECAST
- Extended 16-day weather predictions (Open-Meteo)
- 24h Trend charts for temperature and precipitation
- Wind speed, gusts, and humidity information

⏰ TECHNICAL & GEOLOGICAL DATA
- Wind Compass for direction and speed
- Barometer with 3h pressure trends
- Visibility and Cloud Base height
- Integrated Earthquake monitor for nearby geological activity

🏥 HEALTH & ENVIRONMENT
- UV-Index with color-coded risk levels
- Air Pollutants (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, O3)
- Pollen count (Alder, Birch, Grass)
- Outdoor Activity Score (Jogging, Laundry, Gardening)

🌗 ASTRONOMY & PHOTOGRAPHY
- Graphical Moon Phase display
- Golden Hour and Blue Hour windows for photographers
- Precise sunrise and sunset times

🎨 CUSTOMIZATION
- Material You: Dynamic colors based on your wallpaper
- OLED Black Mode for AMOLED screens

🛡️ 100% PRIVATE & OPEN SOURCE
- No account required, no login needed
- No trackers
- Local JSON Backup & Restore for your cities

Perfect for daily weather checks, travel planning, or simply staying informed without being tracked. Download GeoWeather now!
en-US.name: GeoWeather
en-US.summary: Modern weather app with 16-day forecast for multiple cities

en-US.description:
The Ultimate SuperSMP Companion App - Your Server, Everywhere!

Enhance your SuperSMP Minecraft experience with the official companion app designed for players on the go! Access essential server features, stay connected with the community, and manage your server interactions right from your Android device.

KEY FEATURES:

SMART VOTING SYSTEM
- Vote for the SuperSMP server directly from your phone
- Quick access to all voting platforms
- Track your voting history and rewards
- Never miss daily vote rewards again

INTEGRATED SHOP ACCESS
- Browse the official SuperSMP shop catalog
- View detailed item descriptions and pricing
- Make secure purchases on-the-go
- Real-time inventory updates

INTERACTIVE SERVER MAP
- Access the official SuperSMP world map
- Real-time player locations and activity
- Navigate spawn, warps, and key locations
- Perfect for exploration and planning

MODERN USER INTERFACE
- Built with Jetpack Compose for smooth animations
- Material Design 3 with Dynamic Color support (Android 12+)
- OLED Black Mode for AMOLED screens
- Intuitive navigation optimized for mobile
- Responsive design for all screen sizes

TECHNICAL EXCELLENCE
- Kotlin-first development for performance
- Privacy-focused WebView with tracker blocking
- Modern architecture with MVVM pattern
- Regular updates with new features
- Optimized for battery life and performance

MOBILE OPTIMIZATIONS
- Fast loading times even on slower connections
- Offline mode for cached content
- Push notifications for server events (coming soon)
- Designed for Android 7.0 and above

WHY CHOOSE THIS APP?

FREE & OPEN SOURCE - No hidden costs or subscriptions
SECURE - Your data and accounts are protected
REGULARLY UPDATED - New features and improvements monthly
COMMUNITY DRIVEN - Features requested by players like you
AD-FREE EXPERIENCE - Focus on what matters: your gameplay

PERFECT FOR:

Daily voters who want to maximize rewards
Shop enthusiasts who browse items frequently
Explorers who need map access on-the-go
Community members who stay connected
Players who want convenience without compromise

IMPORTANT NOTE:
This is an unofficial companion app created by fans for the SuperSMP community. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the SuperSMP Minecraft Server team. All server content and branding remain property of their respective owners.

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS:
Android 7.0 (API 24) or higher
50MB free storage space
Internet connection for real-time features

UPCOMING FEATURES:
Player statistics tracking
In-game chat integration
Push notifications for server events
Multi-language support
Offline mode enhancements

COMMUNITY SUPPORT:
Join our growing community of SuperSMP players! Report bugs, request features, and connect with fellow users through our GitHub repository. Your feedback helps shape the future of this app!

Download now and take your SuperSMP experience to the next level!
en-US.name: SuperSMP Companion
en-US.summary: Vote, shop & explore SuperSMP anywhere! Companion app for server features
